paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism
caption: : The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies.
model_annotation: The donut-style pie chart titled “Stimulus Type” shows the distribution of input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, with 10 labeled slices and percentages printed alongside each category (no separate legend is shown, and no slice is visually exploded or offset). The slices include Draft/Other in dark red at about 26.4%, Press Release in mustard/yellow at about 18.7%, External News Article in dark green at about 18.1%, Interview in dark navy at about 8.8%, Organizational Report in medium purple at about 7.7%, Event Posting in deep maroon at about 6.6%, Organizational Website in light purple at about 4.9%, Intra-agency news article in medium blue at about 4.9%, Email in light green at about 2.7%, and Social Media Post in a small orange sliver at about 1.1%. Visually, the ring places the largest dark-red Draft/Other segment on the right side, with the remaining segments arranged around the circle in varying sizes rather than an explicitly uniform or strictly descending sequence.
